description: Use this when the user asks about airport delays, closures or weather right now, such as "is JFK delayed?" or "what is the weather at Heathrow?". Returns: active FAA delays, ground stops and closures with reason and times (US airports only), the latest METAR observation (flight category, temperature, wind, visibility) and the raw TAF forecast. Input tips: pass the four-letter ICAO code (EGLL) for an airport outside the US, or the IATA code (JFK) for a US airport. If status is not_found, ask the user for the ICAO code and call again. Not for: looking up a flight by number (such as BA117), schedules, seats or whether a flight will leave on time, or for flight planning.

airport.description: Airport code, 3 or 4 letters: the four-letter ICAO code such as "EGLL" (London Heathrow) for an airport outside the US, or the three-letter IATA code such as "JFK" for a US airport. Not a city name or a flight number.

name: get_airport_status

airport.description: The code as sent, in capitals.

detail.description: Average, shortest and longest delay and the trend, when given.

reason.description: The FAA's stated reason, such as weather or volume.

since.description: Start time as the FAA writes it (free text, not ISO).

type.description: The FAA program, such as Ground Stop, Ground Delay or Airport Closure, with arrival or departure when given.

until.description: Expected end or reopening time as the FAA writes it (free text, not ISO).

status.description: ok: delays lists every active FAA delay (empty means none). not_applicable: the airport is outside the US, so the FAA has no data.

updated.description: When the FAA feed was updated, as the FAA writes it, such as "Sat Oct 10 17:02:57 2026 GMT".

icao.description: The ICAO code used for the weather, such as KJFK.

message.description: What to tell the user or do next when status is not ok.

metar.description: The latest weather observation, or null when the station has none.

flightCategory.description: VFR (good), MVFR (marginal), IFR (low cloud or poor visibility) or LIFR (very low), as the Aviation Weather Center sets it.

observedAt.description: When the observation was made, as an ISO 8601 UTC time.

station.description: Station name, such as New York/JF Kennedy Intl, NY, US.

visibility.description: Visibility in statute miles, such as "10+ statute miles".

wind.description: Wind direction and speed in knots, such as "200° at 7 kt", or "calm".

notice.description: The limits of this information: not for flight planning.

sources.description: The official sources, to link in the answer.

status.description: ok: see faa, metar and tafRaw. not_found: no station for that code; ask the user for the four-letter ICAO code and call again. invalid: the code is not 3 or 4 letters. unavailable: a source is down; try again in a few minutes. message says the next step.

tafRaw.description: The raw TAF forecast as published, or null when there is none.

title: Get airport status
